「你的名字」赤坂→六本木黄昏登塔＋「天气之子」东京塔・台场夜景，铁板烧晚餐: Your Name in Akasaka and Roppongi at sunset, then Weathering with You views of Tokyo Tower and Odaiba; teppanyaki dinner

新宿三丁目老牌和食。备选：Sururi（4.5）。: Established Japanese restaurant in Shinjuku-sanchome. Alternative: Sururi (4.5).
傍晚：新宿街头散步・圣诞灯饰: Evening: Shinjuku stroll and Christmas lights
新宿东口/南口一带圣诞点灯。: Christmas illuminations around Shinjuku Station's east and south exits.
西新宿1-12-6平价居酒屋，距酒店约6分钟。备选：京王树树林自助（4.2）。: Affordable izakaya at 1-12-6 Nishi-Shinjuku, about 6 minutes from the hotel. Alternative: Keio Plaza's Jurin buffet (4.2).
住宿：新宿华盛顿酒店（连续7晚据点）: Stay: Shinjuku Washington Hotel (base for 7 nights)

入园需门票；冬季9:00开园。: Admission ticket required; opens at 09:00 in winter.
居民区安静打卡。: Visit quietly; this is a residential neighborhood.

坐4楼窗边可复刻『分你一半汉堡』。: Sit by a fourth-floor window to revisit the shared-burger scene.

涩谷2-19-17第106大厦B1和牛拉面（2.8万+评）。备选：Jikasei: Wagyu ramen at 2-19-17 Shibuya, Dai-106 Building B1, with 28,000+ reviews. Alternative: Jikasei MENSHO (4.8).

圣诞巡游+城堡投影+烟花（视天气）12/25收官。先抽热门项目DPA。: Christmas parade, castle projections, and fireworks (weather permitting), ending December 25. Arrange DPA for popular attractions first.
世界市集内美式简餐，点餐快。: Quick American-style meals in World Bazaar.

城堡圣诞投影/烟花，散场预留30-45分钟。: Christmas castle projections and fireworks. Allow 30–45 minutes to leave with the crowds.
片濑海岸人气海鲜食堂（しらす丼）。备选：Kua Aina（4.2）。: Popular seafood restaurant on Katase Beach, serving whitebait bowls. Alternative: Kua Aina (4.2).
晴天可望富士山。: Mount Fuji is visible on clear days.
西新宿7-10-10寿司（4.9/2487评），离酒店步行约12分钟。备选：HI: Sushi at 7-10-10 Nishi-Shinjuku (4.9 from 2,487 reviews), about a 12-minute walk from the hotel. Alternatives: HIBI HARE BARE (4.8), Uogashi (4.5).
你的名字・东急Plaza赤坂前步道桥: Your Name・Footbridge in front of Tokyu Plaza Akasaka
六本木7-9-4寿司（4.8/401评）。备选：SUSHI GARYU东麻布（4: Sushi at 7-9-4 Roppongi (4.8 from 401 reviews). Alternatives: SUSHI GARYU Higashi-Azabu (4.8), Sushi Muku (4.7).
毛利庭园/森美术馆前广场。: Mohri Garden and the plaza in front of Mori Art Museum.
日落约16:30，提前占窗边位。: Sunset is around 16:30; arrive early for a window spot.

海滨风大注意保暖。: The waterfront can be windy; dress warmly.

不忍池畔百年老铺。备选：牛かつあおな（4.2）。: Long-established restaurant beside Shinobazu Pond. Alternative: Gyukatsu Aona (4.2).

上午：退房・最后补货: Morning: Check out and last-minute shopping
